about: Judgements for fixtures/nil-default-census.json and fixtures/nil-default-mixed-sample.json (docs/measurements/nil-default-census.md). Two independent judges per SHAPE row, a third where they disagreed on the verdict or on a contradicting doc; a seeded 40 of the HOLDS rows re-read by hand (reread_*). mixed: the recall probe's classification of the 60 MIXED rows. searches: the free recall searches, capped at 25 finds per group.
